title: Valencia DANA
question: After the 2024 DANA floods, is it raining more and more in Valencia, or is something else changing?
context: On 29 October 2024 a DANA storm dropped months of rain on Valencia in a few hours and killed more than 220 people.

facts.PRECIP:
Place: Valencia (39.470, -0.380)
Variable: PRECIP (mm/day). Data: NASA GPM_3IMERGM v07
Period: 1998-01 to 2025-09, 333 valid months
Trend: 0.00227 mm/day/year (0.0227 mm/day/decade), 95% CI -0.0139 to 0.0177 mm/day/year
Total change over the period: 0.0629 mm/day
Mann-Kendall p-value: p = 0.672, not significant at the 5% level
Direction: no statistically significant trend
A non-significant result means the data show no clear evidence of change, not proof that nothing changed.
facts.T2M:
Place: Valencia (39.470, -0.380)
Variable: T2M (°C). Data: NASA M2TMNXSLV v5.12.4
Period: 1980-01 to 2026-09, 561 valid months
Trend: 0.0312 °C/year (0.312 °C/decade), 95% CI 0.0217 to 0.0409 °C/year
Total change over the period: 1.46 °C
Mann-Kendall p-value: p < 0.001, significant at the 5% level
Direction: increasing
